summary: Of Cozes, mother of Suzanne La Tour; John's 10th-great-grandmother.
bio: Jeanne Meurail lived at Cozes, where her daughter Suzanne La Tour was born on 9 December 1666. She was John's 10th-great-grandmother.
sources: Kenn True Garner, The French Reformed Church, Cozes, Saintonge: Baptisms 1655-1668 (FamilySearch Books); FHL film 1868505 item 5 p.69
